Manual edit

Leave this off and everything stays exactly on the template. Turn it on to drag items on the preview: drag the corner handle to resize, the side handles to reshape a logo, arrow keys to nudge (hold Shift for bigger steps). To change words, double-click any text on the flyer (or click it again once it’s selected): type right on the flyer and use the toolbar that pops up at the top for bold, italic, underline, superscript, subscript and color. Turning it off locks your changes in place; it never undoes them.

To add another logo, use Add another logo in the Logos card.

Logos

An added logo (a youth organization, a sponsor) goes on top of the flyer and never replaces the opponent. It appears in the middle; drag it into place. Manual edit turns on for you.

Recent flyers

Every download and print is filed in the folder of the rep on the flyer. Pick your folder once; it stays open next time.

How the flyer builder works

One page replaces the 36 game files. The flyer layout is locked to the official template; you only fill in the details.

Making a flyer

  1. Pick the game. The page opens on the next home game. Date, time and the opponent logo fill in on their own.
  2. Type the group name and ticket price.
  3. Paste the FEVO link. It prints in the link spot, and a matching QR code goes right below it. Save the QR on its own with the buttons in that card.
  4. Fill the theme night box. Use the B, I, U, size, color and alignment buttons, or the shortcuts in the hint.
  5. Check the deadline. It defaults to the Friday about two weeks before the game; nudge it with the buttons or pick a date.
  6. Pick the rep. Their name, email and phone fill the bottom.

Manual edit (only when needed)

  • Tick Manual edit to unlock the flyer. Drag items to move them, drag the corner handle to resize, and drag a logo’s side handles to reshape it. Arrow keys nudge.
  • Double-click any text on the flyer to type over it. A toolbar appears at the top of the flyer for bold, italic, underline, superscript, subscript and color. Click Done (or anywhere else) when finished.
  • Add text drops a new line on the flyer; its toolbar also has font, size and alignment.
  • Add extra logos (a group’s own logo, a sponsor, or any AHL team) with Add another logo in the Logos card. They never replace the opponent.
  • Unticking locks everything where you left it. Nothing resets unless you click Put this item back or Reset all to template.

Buyer view

  • Buyer view (next to Reset) opens a phone-sized window to the right showing the FEVO link exactly as a fan sees it after scanning the QR code. Switch to Computer for the desktop page. FEVO links can’t load inside the page, so the panel shows a QR code to scan with your phone and a button that opens the page in a phone-sized window beside the builder. It’s the live page, so don’t complete a purchase.

Getting the flyer out

  • Download gives you PNG, JPEG, PowerPoint or PDF, all at 8.5 × 11 and print quality. Print sends the flyer straight to a printer on letter paper; set margins to “None” in the print window if your browser asks.
  • Files are named like the old ones: 26-27 HWP261114 - Group Name - 11.14.26.
  • The PowerPoint is fully editable if you need a one-off change.

Saving

  • Your work saves in this browser as you type. Each download is added to Recent flyers so you can reopen it later; nothing is ever saved over. Recent flyers has a folder for each rep; pick yours once and it stays open. The small × deletes a flyer after you confirm.
  • Opponent logos and reps you add are remembered in this browser. Ask whoever runs the GitHub page to add them for everyone.
